categories.title: Boss
categories.info: Bosses are fought at the end of specific chapters, and so are impossible to miss.

categories.title: Locked Door
categories.info: Locked Doors can only be opened once you've obtained a Key. Any Key will open any Locked Door.

categories.title: Portal
categories.info: Portals are used to jump from one location to another, but must be activated on one end. Unlike with Doors, Luigi can carry objects through a Portal using the Poltergust.

categories.title: Secret Door
categories.info: Hidden doors that you need to reveal by doing a specific action, such as using the Darklight or removing an obstacle.

categories.title: Boo
categories.info: Boos are ghosts that hide in an object that is only invisible in a specific chapter. You need to collect all Boos in a mansion to unlock its Bonus stage.

categories.title: Gem
categories.info: Gems are found by investigating objects or completing specific tasks. Collect all of a mansion's gems to unlock a crystal statue in the Vault.

categories.title: Key
categories.info: Keys can be used to unlock any Locked Door.

categories.title: Treasure
categories.info: Treasure are sources of money, including Coins, Bills and Ingots. We only mark sources worth 40 Coins or more.

locations.title: Shrewd Possessor
locations.description: Fought in D-Boss: Chilly Ride

locations.title: 270 Coins
locations.description:
To the left of the door, vacuum the snow pile to uncover a spool for the dynamite fuse. Vacuum the fuse and drag it right to a torch to light it and blow up the dynamite, blowing down the wall. Check left of the wall to be sucked into a bathysphere.

In this minigame, you'll need to complete the face of the giant snowman. Do so within the time limit to get the money!

locations.title: Crossroads Portal 1A
locations.description: Connects to [Crossroads Portal 1B](#loc=384757).

locations.title: Crossroads Portal 1B
locations.description: Connects to [Crossroads Portal 1A](#loc=384756).

locations.title: Skip Slope Portal 1B
locations.description: Connects to [Skip Slope Portal 1A](#loc=384759).

locations.title: Skip Slope Portal 1A
locations.description: Connects to [Skip Slope Portal 1B](#loc=384758).

locations.title: Pit Mine Portal
locations.description: Connects to the [Deep Hall Portal](#loc=384772).

locations.description: Connects to the [Pit Mine Portal](#loc=384771).

locations.description: Connects to the Chalet Portal.

locations.title: Chalet Portal
locations.description: ONE WAY TRIP from the [Crystal Quarry Portal](#loc=384835).

locations.title: Fishing Hut Secret Door
locations.description: Reveal with the Dark-Light.

locations.title: Smuggler's Hideout Secret Door
locations.description:
To reveal this door in D-2: Hit Rock Bottom, interact with the nearby barrel to reveal a spinner: move it with the vacuum to remove the barricade.

In D-3: Across the Chasm, you'll need to reveal the door using the Dark-Light.

locations.title: Boofoon
locations.description: In D-1: Cold Case, when you return to this area after having gotten the [Airway Key](#loc=384657), use the Dark-Light to reveal this barrel and expose Boofoon.

locations.title: Booger
locations.description: In D-2: Hit Rock Bottom, shine the Dark-Light on the missing chair to reveal this Hidden Boo.

locations.title: ParaBoola
locations.description: In D-3: Across the Chasm, shine the Dark-Light on the missing kettle next to the fire to expose this Hidden Boo.

locations.title: Sapphire #1
locations.description: Use the Dark-Light to reveal a second towel at this spot, then vacuum both of them to reveal the Sapphire.

locations.title: Sapphire #2
locations.description: Vacuum from inside the gap in the floorboards at this spot.

locations.title: Sapphire #3
locations.description: In D-1: Cold Case, fire Toad down the shaft in the back wall to reveal this Sapphire.

locations.title: Sapphire #4
locations.description: Vacuum right out of the crow's nest above this point.

locations.title: Sapphire #5
locations.description:
This Gem requires a bit of setup to acquire. First, use the [Binoculars](#loc=384663) in the northeast corner of this Airway room and look right to spot the Sapphire in an ice mouth on the wall. A bat will then take the Sapphire and drop it into this barrel.

That done, head through the Terminal, Prospector's Crossing, Drift Hall and Basin areas to get to the main section of the Airway. Head north across the bridge, then turn left to find the barrel with this Sapphire in it.

locations.title: Sapphire #6
locations.description: In D-2: Hit Rock Bottom, you can find a frozen gem painting at this spot. Head for the barbecue on the front deck of the chalet: you'll get a roast chicken as you clear the snow piles. Set the chicken alight using the barbecue, then use it to melt the Gem painting. Use the Dark-Light on the painting to get the Sapphire!

locations.title: Sapphire #7
locations.description: In D-2: Hit Rock Bottom, this Gem will be here encased in ice. To free it, shine the Darklight on the front-right wall to reveal a pick-axe. Vacuum it to spin it around and release some wooden planks. You can use them to break the ice and free the Sapphire.

locations.title: Sapphire #8
locations.description: Slip past the turning wheel to access this side path with the Sapphire in it. This may require a few goes to get the timing right from the top of the slide.

locations.title: Sapphire #9
locations.description: In D-2: Hit Rock Bottom, when you get to the bottom of the shaft, yank the chain, then go back up to find this Sapphire in a newly-revealed alcove.

locations.title: Sapphire #10
locations.description: In D-2: Hit Rock Bottom, head into the Pit Mine, activate the conveyor belt, then turn the wheel to drop some coals off in this room. Grab one, light it in the fire, then shoot it at this spot on the ceiling to free the Sapphire.

locations.title: Sapphire #12
locations.description: In D-3: Across the Chasm, return to the Crystal Quarry, then activate and enter the [Crystal Quarry Portal](#loc=384835). You'll arrive back in the Chalet: Luigi will land on a sofa that will spit out this Gem!

locations.title: Sapphire #11
locations.description: In D-3: Across the Chasm, shine the Dark-Light on the missing crate. Vacuum the spirit balls that appear on the other side of the room, then come back and vacuum the pile of snow to reveal the Sapphire!

locations.title: Sapphire #13
locations.description:
In D-3: Across the Chasm, use the [Gondola Coal Shooter](#loc=384845) to unthaw a tree and make it fall into a bridge to this spot. Enter the lighthouse and defeat the Hiders with snowballs to win the Sapphire!

The first two Hiders will also award you 15 and 100 Coins.

locations.title: Airway Key
locations.description: In D-1: Cold Case, shoot Toad into the raised scale to reveal this Key in the other, in a pile of snow.

locations.title: Drift Hall Key
locations.description:
In D-1: Cold Case, vacuum the snow pile around this chest, then open it for the Key.

In later stages, reveal the chest with the Dark-Light to get 95 Coins.

locations.title: Crossroads Key
locations.description: Take through the Portal and defrost it using the flaming lantern.

locations.title: Skip Slope Key
locations.description: Launch off the right-hand ice ramp.

locations.title: Cinder Mine Key
locations.description: Defrost with a flaming log to get this Key.

locations.title: 95 G
locations.description: In D-1: Cold Case, vacuum the pile of snow at this point to reveal a chest with cash inside.

locations.title: 50 G
locations.description: In D-1: Cold Case and D-2: Hit Rock Bottom, vacuum the snow at the base of the tree and then kick it, releasing two Gold Crows.

locations.title: 37 G
locations.description: In D-1: Cold Case, look through the window of this room to spy on a Hider, who'll spot you and rock on the chair, releasing these Coins. Quickly head in and grab them!

locations.title: 20 G
locations.description: In D-1: Cold Case, flash the barbecue to defrost the Gold Ingot.

locations.title: 110 G
locations.description: In D-1: Cold Case, yank the tail of the polar bear rug to release a Golden Greenie.

locations.title: 95 G
locations.description: In D-1: Cold Case, after defeating the ghosts, use one of the burning coals to defrost a rope hanging from the ceiling. Vacuum the rope to open a compartment that spits out these Coins.

locations.title: 180 G
locations.description: Shoot the nearby [Hockey Puck](#loc=384647) into this goal to reveal two Golden Greenies, once of which has a helmet and the other attacking with a hockey stick.

locations.title: 40 G
locations.description: Suck up all three fish hanging from the fishing poles to get these Coins from the bucket of fish.

locations.title: 95 G
locations.description: In D-1: Cold Case, inside the chest under the ice slide.

locations.title: 95 G
locations.description: In D-1: Cold Case, vacuum both lures hanging out of the fish's mouth to reveal a Golden Greenie.

locations.title: 80 G
locations.description: From the upper level, vacuum the snow pile to reveal a geyser that launches you to four Gold Ingots. You can use the nearby lure ball to get back down.

locations.title: 105 G
locations.description: In D-1: Cold Case, vacuum the pick-axe here to unscrew a section of the wall and get these coins. Also vacuum the poster on the opposite wall to reveal a Gold Spider.

locations.title: 90 G
locations.description: In D-1: Cold Case, return to the Chalet with Toad, then suck up the Gold Fuzzball and launch it across the room three times to get Coins.

locations.title: 90 G
locations.description: In In D-2: Hit Rock Bottom, open the shaking drawers to release a Golden Fuzzball.

locations.title: 20 G
locations.description: In D-2: Hit Rock Bottom, flash the Gold Crow at this spot.

locations.title: 60 G
locations.description: Vacuum the pick-axe on this spot to fling it into the ceiling, breaking the ice and letting you vacuum down three Gold Ingots.

locations.title: 60 G
locations.description: Yank this rope to drop a small bucket, which will hit into the wall to reveal three Golden Mice.

locations.title: 150 G
locations.description: Suck up the poster on this wall to reveal a raised alcove with two wads of Bills inside.

locations.title: 75 G
locations.description: In D-2: Hit Rock Bottom, defrost the arms of this suit of armor to have it whack the one on the ground, releasing three Gold Bats.

locations.title: 90 G
locations.description: As you descend down the shaft, nab this Golden Ghoulie in the split second he passes by in the background.

locations.title: 75 G
locations.description: In D-2: Hit Rock Bottom, vacuum this wheel to lower the lantern into the chasm. When the red eyes show up, stop to release three Gold Bats.

locations.title: 90 G
locations.description: In D-2: Hit Rock Bottom, peep through the hole here to spot a Golden Greenie. When you exit, it will appear in the room alongside a Sneaker.

locations.title: 90 G
locations.description: In D-3: Across the Chasm, suck up this snow pile to reveal a Gold Fuzzball.

locations.title: 100 G
locations.description: In D-3: Across the Chasm, head to the upper floor and vacuum the painting on the right. Flash the safe behind the painting to get the cash.

locations.title: 60 G
locations.description: In D-3: Across the Chasm, three Gold Spiders appear at this point. Flash 'em!

locations.title: 95 G
locations.description: In D-3: Across the Chasm, unthaw using the [Gondola Coal Shooter](#loc=384845).

locations.title: 60 G
locations.description: In D-3: Across the Chasm, three Gold Ingots rest on the left-hand pipe.

locations.title: Hockey Puck
locations.description: Shoot into the [Hockey Goal](#loc=384646).

locations.title: Binoculars
locations.description: Use these to make [Sapphire #5](#loc=384662) accessible.

locations.title: Coal Shooter
locations.description: Use this to cross the chasm, as well as access [Sapphire #13](#loc=384847) and [95 Coins](#loc=384851).
